description: A test file for commands configuration and behavior, testing functions such as resolveNativeSkillsEnabled, resolveNativeCommandsEnabled, isNativeCommandsExplicitlyDisabled, isRestartEnabled, and isCommandFlagEnabled within a plugin system.

methods.name: resolveNativeSkillsEnabled
methods.description: Determines if native skills are enabled for a given provider based on provider-specific and global settings.

methods.name: resolveNativeCommandsEnabled
methods.description: Determines if native commands are enabled for a given provider based on provider-specific and global settings.

methods.name: isNativeCommandsExplicitlyDisabled
methods.description: Checks if native commands are explicitly disabled based on provider or global fallback settings.

methods.name: isRestartEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the restart command is enabled, defaulting to true unless explicitly disabled.

methods.name: isCommandFlagEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a specific command flag is enabled within a command configuration.
